Good morning, everyone!

Today, I want to talk about something we all experience: failure.

Now, I know what you’re thinking… “Failure? That’s not exactly the most exciting topic.” And honestly, I agree.

But think about it. How many times have we tried something, failed, and immediately thought, “Well… I’m never doing that again”? Probably more times than we’d like to admit.

The truth is, failure can be uncomfortable. Sometimes, it can be embarrassing. You study for a test and get a lower grade than you expected. You give a presentation and forget what you were going to say. Or you try something new, completely mess it up, and just stand there thinking… “What just happened?”

I’ve definitely been there.

But failure isn't something we should be ashamed of. It’s how we learn. Every mistake gives us information about what we can do differently next time.

Ah—excuse me!

See? Even this speech didn’t go exactly as planned. 

And that’s the point. We spend so much time trying to be perfect that we forget something important: we’re human.

We will make mistakes. We will have bad days. We will sometimes make completely ridiculous decisions. And that’s okay.

What matters is what we do afterward.

Instead of saying, “I failed,” try saying, “I learned something.”

Instead of giving up, take a breath. Take another step. And if you fall again… get back up.

Because success isn't about never failing.

It’s about failing, learning, trying again, and eventually becoming better than you were before.

So the next time something doesn’t go your way, don’t be afraid of failure.

Learn from it.

Laugh at it.

And most importantly… keep going.

Thank you.
